fields.label: Analytics Publisher Identities
fields.help: Array of service accounts authorized to publish analytics data to the control plane, each specified using the following format: 'serviceAccount:service-account-name'.

fields.label: Synchronizer Identities
fields.help: Array of service accounts to grant access to control plane resources (for the Synchronizer component), each specified using the following format: 'serviceAccount:service-account-name'.
